reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000927 (the melody read from 000927a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. T. Tertius Noble's dates (1867–1953) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Noble_TT (T. Tertius Noble, 1867-1953; ORA LABORA, 1918); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/T._Tertius_Noble agrees; CCEH's page gives only the year 1918. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000927a.nwc). The tune ends on C, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
